token.title: 🔑 GitHub biindigewin
token.intro: GitHub onakwetaan 60 andotamaagewinan endaso-diba'igan imaa gaa-maajiinigesig biindigewin. Gakina baketawin-mitig 32 igo andotamaagewinan onandawendaan, mii iw eko-niizhing bi-izhaayan gaawiin andotamaagewinan ayaasinoon. Biindigewin ombiwebinaan gibichii'igewin biinish 5000 endaso-diba'igan.
token.step1: Baakinan Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, miinawaa Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: giin gidaabajichigan. Expiration: aanapii go giizhigad; mitig gaawiin gegoo ginwenzh ji-ayaamagak onandawendanziin.
token.step4: Gego aanjitooken gakina bagidinigewinan. Meta gakina-ayaag asanjigowinan onji gaawiin gegoo onandawendanziinan.
token.step5: Ozhitoon, miinawaa naasaabibii'an {token} ezhi-apiitendaagwak. GitHub bezhigwaa eta go owaabanda'iwen.
token.classic: Gete-biindigewin gaye anokiimagad: ozhitoon gaawiin gegoo bagidinigewin gikinawaajitoosiwan. Gaawiin gegoo bagidinigewin mii go gaye agindamaagemagad gakina-ayaag, dibishkoo gaa-nisidawinaawind izhi-apiichi.
token.stays: Omaa babaamaabanjiganing danakii {key} aabaabika'iganing, miinawaa {host} eta go izhaamagad. Gaawiin wiikaa ozhibii'igaadesinoon imaa ayaang-miikanensing, mii iw dakobijigan gaa-maada'ooniyan owaabanjigan odayaan, gaawiin biindigewin. Daanganigan anaamayi'ii ozhibii'iganing miinawaa gaasiitoon, ganawenjigan gaye.
token.persistHow: Atoon biindigewin imaa {env} mazina'iganing miinigewi-mazinaabikiwebinigan gaa-ganawendang o'ow mazina'igan, jiigayi'ii {port}:
token.proxy: miinawaa maajitoon {make} aabajitooyan. Mii dash makak ozhibii'ang nginx bangii-ozhibii'igan gaa-dakobidood {header} ishpiming-ozhibii'igan imaa {path} naabishkaagewin, mii iw babaamaabanjigan wiin odondinigewin andotang, gaawiin wiikaa odaadisiin biindigewin. O'ow ozhibii'igan wanishinomagad miinawaa gakina bi-mawadishiwejig bezhig gibichii'igewin, 5000 endaso-diba'igan, maada'oonidiwag.
fork.refused404: Gaawiin wadikwan-miikanensan: {message}. 404 omaa, gemaa wadikwan gaa-ayaasinog, gemaa miikana miinigewi-mazinaabikiwebinigan naabishkaagewin gaa-bimiwidoosig; aanapii go, baketawin-asab ishpiming giizhisemagad.
fork.refusedExhausted: GitHub gaawiin andotamaagewinan odayaanziin o'ow diba'igan, mii iw gaawiin gii-ozhibii'igaadesinoon wadikwan-miikanensan. Baketawin-asab ishpiming giizhisemagad. Atoon biindigewin imaa zhaabobiiginigan-apishimonkaaning, gemaa gibaakwan wadikwan-miikanensan imaa izhinaagwak-apishimonkaaning, ji-aabajitooyan gibichii'igewin asab eta go.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub gii-nakwetam {status} atoowin-dibaajimowinan onji, mii iw gaawiin gii-ozhibii'igaadesinoon wadikwan-miikanensan. Baketawin-asab ishpiming giizhisemagad.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Gikinawaajichigan gaawiin giizhigad odayaanziin, mii iw endaso gaa-ishkoseg bezhig andotamaagewin da-aabajitoon, miinawaa gaa-ishkoseg diba'igan gibichii'igewin gaawiin imaa aabajichigaadesinoon.
